home.title: Africa’s money, without borders.
home.subtitle: Send money to anyone in seconds, pay any shop with a scan, and pay suppliers across borders — with every rate and fee shown before you confirm. One wallet for everyday life and cross-border trade.
benefits: Scan to pay at spaza shops, taxis and market stalls — no card machine
ZAR, BWP and USD side by side — never mixed
Pay suppliers across borders instantly or with Protected Escrow

features.title: Zero-fee transfers
features.body: Pay friends and family by @username, phone number or QR. Money moves between BukkaPay wallets instantly — and free.

features.title: Scan to pay
features.body: One scan at the counter, the taxi rank or the market stall. The merchant is paid instantly into their BukkaPay balance.

features.title: ZAR, BWP and USD wallets
features.body: Keep a separate balance in each currency and switch in a tap. You see the exchange rate before you swap or pay.

features.title: Pay suppliers across borders
features.body: Pay a wholesaler in Gaborone from Johannesburg instantly, or use Protected Escrow: the money is held until you confirm your goods arrived.

features.title: PDF trade receipts for the border
features.body: Download a tamper-evident PDF receipt for every supplier payment, naming buyer, seller, goods, HS codes and the rate, for smooth border clearance.

features.title: Book flights in seconds
features.body: Search domestic and pan-African flights across airlines and pay from your ZAR, BWP or USD wallet balance with your PIN. Your booking reference arrives instantly.

features.title: Instant virtual Visa cards
features.body: Create a virtual Visa card in seconds to shop online worldwide and tap to pay where Visa is accepted, once card issuing launches in your country. Freeze it any time.

features.title: Payment links & invoices
features.body: Share a link or an itemised invoice on WhatsApp and watch it marked paid the moment the money arrives.

features.title: Stokvels & contributions
features.body: Pool money for a family event or a stokvel — with a clear, shared record of who paid.

useCases.title: Your phone is the till
useCases.body: Show your QR code and get paid on the spot, at a low merchant fee. Start with just your ID — no business registration needed.

useCases.title: Buy stock without carrying cash
useCases.body: Pay suppliers across the border from your wallet, keep the receipt for the border post, and leave the cash risk behind.

useCases.title: Invoice buyers in their currency
useCases.body: Send itemised invoices to buyers in neighbouring countries and get settled in your own currency.

useCases.title: Fares without the cash box
useCases.body: Passengers scan and pay; you see every fare as it lands, and cash never has to change hands.

useCases.title: Send home in seconds
useCases.body: Support family across town or across the border — free between BukkaPay wallets, with the rate shown upfront.

pricing.intro: Start free. You only pay a fee when you get paid.
pricing.footnote: Transaction fees are shown before every payment.

items.question: What is BukkaPay?
items.answer: BukkaPay is a cash-free wallet for Africa. Send money free between wallets, pay shops and taxis with a QR scan, hold ZAR, BWP and USD, book flights, and — soon — pay suppliers across borders with escrow protection and border-ready receipts.

items.question: Which currencies can I hold?
items.answer: South African rand (ZAR), Botswana pula (BWP) and US dollars (USD) to start, each in its own balance. Balances are never mixed, and every exchange rate is shown before you swap or pay.

items.question: What is Protected Escrow Pay?
items.answer: When you pay a supplier with escrow, your money is held safely by BukkaPay — not by the seller — until you confirm you've received the goods (or delivery is verified). If something goes wrong, our team reviews the dispute and the money goes back to you or on to the seller. Escrow is coming soon.

items.question: Can I book flights with BukkaPay?
items.answer: Yes. Search fares, add passengers exactly as on their ID or passport, and pay from a wallet in the fare's currency with your PIN. You get a booking reference straight away.

items.question: Is it available in my country?
items.answer: See the Countries page — it shows exactly where BukkaPay is live, piloting or planned, straight from our live configuration.

items.question: Who holds my money?
items.answer: Customer funds are held by licensed financial institutions in each country where BukkaPay operates. BukkaPay runs the technology on top.

items.question: How do I get a Visa card?
items.answer: Every wallet gets its own virtual Visa card once you've verified your ID and cards are available in your country. You can add it to Apple Pay or Google Pay to tap to pay.

items.question: Can I accept payments without a registered business?
items.answer: Yes. Street vendors, tuck shops and informal traders can start with just their verified ID, up to individual seller limits. Registered businesses verify once and have higher limits.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: Every fee and exchange rate is shown before you confirm a payment. There are no hidden charges.

items.question: Is BukkaPay a bank?
items.answer: No. BukkaPay is a payment technology company. Customer funds are held and settled by licensed local financial institutions in each country where we operate.

items.question: What happens if a cross-border transfer fails?
items.answer: If it can't be delivered, the full amount, including the fee, is returned to your wallet.

items.question: Why do I need to verify my identity?
items.answer: Regulations require it, and it protects you. Your limits increase as you complete verification.

items.question: How do businesses get paid out?
items.answer: Businesses request payouts to a verified bank account. A payout shows as settled only once the bank confirms it.

items.question: Are community contributions an investment?
items.answer: No. They collect money for a shared purpose and are not a savings, deposit or investment product.
